verdict.rationale: MX markets a consumer-facing experience where users "ask about their money in plain language and act on the answer" [mx-docs-27]. A probe found an official MCP server documented at docs.mx.com/mcp [mx-probe-3], which would let an external AI agent drive MX through natural language. An llms.txt [mx-probe-1] supports LLM-assisted use. However, natural-language operation runs through third-party agents or an embedded consumer feature, not a first-party command interface for operating the platform itself. missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for operators/developers, detailed docs on the MCP server's tools and capabilities, hands-on or independent corroboration that NL operation works.
